`be32toh` comes from glibc's <endian.h>, which QNX 8.0 does not have. QNX has the same names as BSD macros in <net/netbyte.h>; a small header (-included in every compile) includes it and defines any name strict POSIX flags hid, from QNX's __NET_BE*/__NET_LE* helpers.
